'''Saak Sooin''' was the single [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] of the [[Neimoidia system/Legends|Neimoidia system]]. Located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], it was set into the fourth orbital position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Nen/Legends|Nen]]. It had valuable minerals under its surface found by miners in 13 BBY.
